verdict.rationale: RustDesk describes itself as an AGPL-licensed remote desktop client with an OSS server. Its public GitHub repository can be cloned and built, and it exposes internal modules such as libs/clipboard. A community member also discussed reading the code directly, which independently confirms the source is readable. missing for 10: the commercial Server Pro features (web console, access control, management API) are not shown to be open source, and no license file is cited from the repository itself.
